title.narrative: Teachers ready to use AI for education resources development

description.narrative: In collaboration with Ministries of Education of the San Jose cluster, UNESCO will develop a free MooC targeted to teachers to use AI for the production of teaching resources, in particular in subject areas prioritized during ministerial meetings held by the Central American Culture and Education Coordination for the SICA region (CECC-SICA), such as fundamental skill. The course will include approaches aligned with UNESCO tools and existing materials, including competency guidelines, AI Recommendation, Media and Information Literacy (MIL), digital citizenship, Recommendation 2023, etc. Special interest will be placed on how these resources are created and use in rural areas and with indigenous populations.
